in_marathi.name: Koti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Power, Wealth, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Koti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Koti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kotir' which means 'a crore' or 'a million'. This name is considered auspicious and is often given to boys to bless them with wealth, power, and prosperity.
